meta.title: The event card shows evaluation as pending, overdue or completed at the right moments
gaps: The available setup creates only one technical round and one invited vendor response, not two technical rounds, two responses, an RFI, or line-level scoring.
No operation or readable field exposes the event-card evaluation status, so pending, overdue, and completed cannot be asserted.
No operation submits a valid evaluator score, requests line re-evaluation, or creates a second response.

The available wait is capped at six minutes, while the published_rfp_rfq setup keeps rounds open for about twenty minutes; the plan does not check states after bidding ends or after the extra closing time passes.
The available read-backs do not expose active response scores, active line scores, re-evaluation requests, or the rule that an RFI is completed after any active evaluation.
The available vocabulary does not provide a setup or operation for a round moved to auction.

words.preconditions: A fresh RFP + RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited to both rounds; both open for about 20 minutes.
steps: The buyer reads the technical round.
As the buyer, read the event and check that Data check: “status” equals active; Schema check: “stages” is not empty.
As the buyer, read the technical round and check that Data check: “status” equals active; Schema check: “ending at” is a Unix timestamp in seconds.
words.expected: The app accepts it. Read back afterwards: Data check: “status” equals active; Schema check: “stages” is not empty; Data check: “status” equals active; Schema check: “ending at” is a Unix timestamp in seconds.
